title: Rafael and the Archive
author: Beatrix Kavanagh
blurb: Casper Okonkwo, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
